subject: Partner-led discovery: Cloudbridge marketplace - next steps
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 14:02:00 -0800
Subject: Thanks + next steps (Cloudbridge x Redwood)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro call today. Raj and I enjoyed the overview of Redwood and think there's strong alignment for a marketplace integration on Cloudbridge. As discussed, next step would be a partner-led technical deep dive/demo for our platform team so they can validate integration patterns and capacity expectations.

Proposed agenda (30–45m):
- Quick context and use-cases (Cloudbridge) — 5m
- Redwood overview focused on Dedicated & Private deployment options — 10m
- Technical deep dive: auth, routing, quota controls, and deployment patterns — 20m
- Q&A + next steps (action items & timeline) — 5–10m

Can we align on a time next week? Here are a few windows that work for our engineers (PST):
- Tue 20 Jan: 9:00–10:00am or 2:00–3:00pm
- Wed 21 Jan: 11:00–11:45am
- Thu 22 Jan: 1:00–2:00pm

I’ve attached a short one-pager and a proposed agenda — feel free to edit. Also — can you include your SE/engineering lead on the invite (we'll loop in our infra lead)?

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Partnerships, Cloudbridge
Attachments: Cloudbridge_Redwood_1Pager.pdf; proposed-agenda.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudbridge.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps (Cloudbridge x Redwood)

Hi Sophie —

Great to meet you both — appreciate the clear agenda. Mateo (cc'd) is our lead solutions engineer and will join the technical deep dive. Connor (product) may sit in as well depending on timing.

From our side the following windows (PST) look good:
- Tue 20 Jan: 2:00–3:00pm
- Wed 21 Jan: 11:00–11:45am (tight but possible)
- Thu 22 Jan: 1:00–2:00pm

We prefer Tue 20 at 2pm PT if that works for your infra team. Mateo — can you confirm availability and whether you'd like a specific demo focus (auth, KV cache behavior under multi-tenant load, or routing/fallback logic)?

If Tue works I'll ask our ops team to send a calendar invite with a short pre-read link and include a brief environment checklist for the demo.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships (Americas)
Redwood Inference

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie@cloudbridge.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps (Cloudbridge x Redwood)

Hi Sophie / Marissa —

Thanks for the sync. Tue 20 Jan 2:00pm PT works for me. For the demo I'd propose the following technical focus so we hit Cloudbridge's gating questions:
- Auth & onboarding flow (API key vs OIDC integration) — 8–10m
- Routing & model selection policies for marketplace (latency/cost tiers) — 8–10m
- Batching, KV cache behavior, and expected throughput for multi-tenant marketplace workloads — 10–12m
- QA: scale testing considerations and SLAs — remaining time

Two quick asks for an efficient session:
1) Please share a high-level diagram of Cloudbridge's intended call path (auth layer, proxy, and any existing rate-limiting/fairshare) so we can tailor the deep dive.
2) If you want us to demonstrate a small scale synthetic run, include a test API key or ephemeral endpoint (we can demo with redacted creds) — otherwise we'll do a walkthrough with recorded runs and logs.

I'll prepare a 20–25 slide technical deck and a short runbook. Looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Turner <sophie@cloudbridge.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Thanks + next steps (Cloudbridge x Redwood)

Thanks — Tue 20 at 2:00pm PT is perfect. I created a calendar event and included the Cloudbridge infra lead and our marketplace product manager. Link below.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=cloudbridge-demo-20260120
Drive (diagram): https://drive.google.com/open?id=0BzCloudbridge-Redwood-demo-agenda

We'll plan for 45 minutes. For the demo we'll aim to provide a narrow call-path diagram before EOD Monday (19 Jan). We'll also share a sanitized test key if you'd like a live run — otherwise we'll default to a walkthrough.

See you Tuesday,
Raj Patel
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Cloudbridge
